entities.name: TBS protecting group
observations: The O–Si substituent pattern is consistent with tert-butyldimethylsilyl (TBS/TBDMS), with silicon bonded to oxygen, two methyl groups, and a tert-butyl group.

entities.name: TBS ether deprotection
observations: The product is the corresponding alcohol formed by cleavage of a terminal TBS silyl ether; the remaining ester groups, alkyne, heteroaromatic nitrogens, and cyclic ether are retained.
Common candidate conditions include TBAF in THF at 0 °C to room temperature, NH4F in methanol or alcohol, and HF·pyridine or Et3N·3HF when stronger cleavage is needed.
A direct reaction record supports conversion of a TBS-protected alcohol to the alcohol under chloride/acidic workup conditions.
